title: ageratina irrasa
intro: Ageratina irrasa, commonly known as Mexican oregano or Mexican mint, is a perennial herb belonging to the mint family. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, boost the immune system, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Ageratina irrasa include its ability to relax muscles, reduce anxiety, and promote a good night's sleep due to its sedative properties. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
